speaker: Lizard
text: I've got a lock on the door AND a chair under the handle. That's a whole system.

speaker: Lizard
text: So how'd you get in? Chimney? Vent? Did you just... walk through the wall?

speaker: Lizard
text: Explain yourself. Enter, space, click, whatever, just answer me.

choices.text: I just went through the door

speaker: You
text: I just went through the door.

speaker: Lizard
text: Through the door. THE DOOR. Do you understand what I built here?

speaker: Lizard
text: Triple-reinforced deadbolt. A chair. A CHAIR, wedged at the precise angle for maximum resistance.

speaker: Lizard
text: I calculated the angle. I have a diagram. It's on the fridge.

speaker: Lizard
text: And you just... turned the handle. Unbelievable. My defenses were supposed to be impeccable.

speaker: Lizard
text: Well that's not very helpful, is it?

speaker: Lizard
text: Well no matter, I need to ask you something.

speaker: Lizard
text: My friend Chips has gone missing. She usually turns up by now, without fail.

speaker: Lizard
text: Last I saw her, she was heading out back, muttering something about a noise she'd heard.

speaker: Lizard
text: That was two days ago. Nothing since. No note, no sign, nothing.

speaker: Lizard
text: I need you to go find her. Please.
